title: Graduate Civil Engineer
content_text: Graduate Civil Engineer, Robert Bird Group Pty Ltd, Melbourne. We're looking for Graduate Civil Engineers with an interest in developing a career within our Melbourne civil works and infrastructure team. Contribute to major industry projects and local community ventures; assist in proposals, reports and documents; buddy system; graduate development workshops. About You: Graduates will be in their final year, or have graduated within the last 2 years. Strong interpersonal and written communication skills. Positive attitude and willingness to learn. Ability to effectively manage one's time and workload. A developed knowledge of analytical methods, tools, and principles. How to Apply: All applications must be submitted online. Include a copy of your CV and academic transcript. RBG program page (robertbird.com) separately notes Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Science in civil, structural or construction engineering for the Spirit of Excellence Graduate Development Program; the October 2025 email cycle at employment@robertbird.com.au is currently closed, so this Workday posting is the live apply path.
apply_instructions: Apply online on Workday with CV and academic transcript. Do not email the closed employment@ cycle.
